purpose: Context for repeated high active current, not isolated C14 effect
limitations: Historical control differs in U42 and possibly SD LED population and card history.
Time zero is current-onset threshold. First5ms omitted from contextual cycle energy.
Phase-dependent intervals overlap and are not component-only power measurements.
Mean-current and energy changes are not explained solely by duration differences.
No independent target-rail measurement or attribution of abnormal load.
